assessment: Several calendar forecasts are sharply testable: May CPI above 4.5% and infrastructure enactment were right, while a summer inflation peak and no substantial 2022 rate hikes were wrong. The GBTC discussion identifies the discount mechanism but mistakenly calls a lockup-dependent premium trade risk-free. Bank risks require more care: rising rates can produce acute losses, not merely slow margin erosion.
